clock.n: Forward hour-only transition to22 or next12 over2 real seconds; set_hour called each render.
clock.t: T stops only clock.advance and cancels an active N transition. It does not pause scene physics.
clock.current_limit: No day index; advance reduces delta modulo full cycle and therefore intentionally loses whole-cycle count.
clock.narrow_extension: Keep one shared clock. Add day index, count normalized forward midnight wraps once in set_hour; separately count full midnight crossings in advance. Do not increment floor(input_hour/24) on every N render.
clock.advance_crossing_formula: With existing elapsed seconds on06:00 axis: floor((elapsed+delta+900)/5400)-floor((elapsed+900)/5400). Equivalent whole-cycle+remainder implementation can bound arithmetic.
clock.schedule_ticket_rule: Use stable source ID plus day index plus routine slot for eligibility; actual receipt marks completion. Preserve active ticket across bank/interruptions and clock jumps. Lifecycle ownership still binds current generation.
